verdict.rationale: Docs describe automatic risk controls and platform-owned controls for returns, negative balances, and outbound money movement (docs-14, docs-22), showing some fraud-prevention tooling. However, there is no documentation of who bears losses for ACH return fraud, card disputes, or account takeover — the explicit liability split the finance-lead story requires is absent. missing for 10: explicit liability allocation table/clauses for ACH return fraud, card dispute losses, and ATO losses; any statement on platform vs Stripe vs connected-account financial responsibility.
